main.description: Gets one public acknowledgement by exact AT-URI; authentication is not required.

uri.description: Acknowledgement record AT-URI with a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify an acknowledgement record.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No acknowledgement is indexed at this AT-URI.

errors.name: AcknowledgementQueryFailed
errors.description: The acknowledgement or publisher lookup failed.
